success.purpose: Functional done/complete state only — never a brand voice.

display.purpose: Brand shout — today-card titles, poster moments. Uppercase.

greeting.purpose: Top-of-screen address / page title; sentence case.

metric.purpose: Hero numbers — loudest element on any screen; often tabular.

data.purpose: Eyebrows, dates, stat labels, readouts — the instrument's metadata voice.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default press/state easing — exponential, no bounce.

motion.name: theme-fade
motion.purpose: Smooth light/dark switch on the root.

themes.model: data-theme on <html>; :root = light (paper), [data-theme="dark"] = ink. An inline boot script resolves auto/light/dark before first paint. useTheme hook persists the choice and follows OS on auto.

components.name: Primary Button (action)
components.description: The pink CTA — ink text, never white.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF2E7E; color: #15140F; font-family: 'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; padding: 16px; width: 100%; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border: none; border-radius: 14px; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Today Card
components.description: The day's single most important action — a drenched pink block with an inverted CTA.
components.html:
Entreno de hoy
Día 4 · Pierna
Empezar entreno
components.css: .ds-today { background: #FF2E7E; color: #15140F; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; } .ds-today__ey { font-family: 'Space Mono',monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-today__t { font-family: 'Anton',sans-serif; font-size: 24px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-today__cta { background: #15140F; color: #FF2E7E; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px; text-align: center; font-family: 'Archivo'; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; margin-top: 12px; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Etched surface — hero metric over a mono label.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F4F2EB; border: 1px solid rgba(21,20,15,0.12); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Space Mono',monospace; color: #5A584F; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-metric { font-family: 'Archivo',sans-serif; color: #15140F; font-size: 40px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.9; margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: PR Badge
components.description: Record marker — lime fill, ink text. States the win and stops.
components.css: .ds-pr { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #C0EE2E; color: #15140F; font-family: 'Archivo'; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Surface-2 field with a pink focus-visible ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #DFDCD2; border: 1px solid rgba(21,20,15,0.22); color: #15140F; font-family: 'Archivo'; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; width: 100%; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #646359; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF2E7E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mono Eyebrow
components.description: Section label / timestamp — the instrument metadata voice.
components.css: .ds-eybrow { font-family: 'Space Mono',monospace; color: #2438FF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Tab
components.description: Thumb-zone tab — active turns Action-Pink, inactive is Ink-Ghost.
components.html: Inicio
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 0; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Space Mono',monospace; } .ds-tab__icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #9A988E; } .ds-tab__label { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #9A988E; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab__icon, .ds-tab--active .ds-tab__label { color: #FF2E7E; }

narrative.overview: Raw reads like a risograph print run wired to a stadium scoreboard. A stark paper-or-ink field, heavyweight type set tight, hairline structure, and flat blocks of one or two spot colors — onto which Raw runs voltage: fluorescent pink for act, electric blue for data, acid lime for a record. Two true modes (paper light, ink dark) share one layout and flip only the spine; a boot script resolves auto/light/dark before first paint. Rejects the SaaS dashboard, the bloated fitness app, and the corporate-clinical look.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers are the content — 30-64px, weight 900, tight tracking.
Role-based color rationed hard: pink act, blue data, lime record.
Two real modes — paper and ink, auto-resolved, AA-verified.
Committed type voice — Anton + Archivo 900 + Space Mono, self-hosted.
Flat print structure — hairline borders, never drop-shadowed cards.
Thumb-first with a glass bottom-nav spine.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Brand color speaks exactly three words — pink act, blue data, lime record. A color outside its role is removed. Success-green is the one deliberate exception: a functional done/complete state, never a brand voice.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Pink Rule
rules.body: Text on an Action-Pink fill is always ink, never white — white fails AA on this pink (3.7:1), ink clears it (5.2:1).

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Must-read text never renders lighter than Ink-Muted (>=4.9:1 in either mode). Ink-Ghost is decoration only.

rules.name: The Number-As-Hero Rule
rules.body: The most important figure is the largest, heaviest, darkest element. Shrink chrome, never the number.

rules.name: The Mono-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels are Space Mono, not Archivo. The instrument speaks metadata in monospace.

rules.name: The Etched-Not-Floated Rule
rules.body: Cards separate via a 1px border + surface lift, never box-shadow.

dos: Do keep the most important number the largest, heaviest, darkest element.
Do speak color in three voices — pink act, blue data, lime record.
Do use ink text on every pink fill; reach for Action-Text only for pink labels on paper.
Do keep readable text at Ink-Muted or darker; Ink-Ghost is decoration only.
Do supply chart colors as literal hex per theme (CSS vars don't resolve in recharts SVG).
Do separate surfaces with a 1px border + lift, not a shadow.
Do keep tap targets >=44px and pair every record/live signal with a label or icon.
Do ship a prefers-reduced-motion fallback and honor the user's theme choice.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard — no gradient tiles, pastel charts, or cards-everywhere sameness.
Don't add dopamine theatre — no confetti, streak spam, or badges. A PR is stated in lime.
Don't drift corporate-clinical — keep the Anton/Archivo weight and fluoro palette.
Don't put white text on the Action-Pink fill, or render must-read text in Ink-Ghost.
Don't use lime for anything but a record, or spend color on decoration.
Don't invert one theme to fake the other — light is paper, dark is ink, each tuned on its own.
Don't add a card drop shadow, a side-stripe accent border, or a fourth web font.
